title: Warp
constraintsSummary: Time limit: 3 sec; Memory limit: 1024 MiB; Constraints: 1 \leq N \leq 300; 0 \leq M \leq 10^5; -10^9 \leq A,B,C,D,E,F \leq 10^9; (A,B), (C,D), and (E,F) are distinct.; -10^9 \leq X_i,Y_i \leq 10^9; (X_i,Y_i)\neq(0,0); (X_i,Y_i) are distinct.; All values in input are integers.
